# netskopebwan_device_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated from the provider's schema: the arguments this object requires, with
# placeholders to fill in. Remove these two lines to maintain the example by hand.
resource "netskopebwan_device_group" "example" {
  address      = "<address>"
  address_type = "ipv4"
  group_name   = "example"
  segment_id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address of the device group
- `address_type` (String) Type of the Address Object Must be one of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `mac`.
- `group_name` (String) Name of the device group
- `segment_id` (Number) Segment id for this address

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the device group
- `metadata_tags` (List of String) Optional metadata tags to classify the address group
- `serial_no` (String) Appliance Serial Number for this device either siteId or serialNo must be present
- `site_id` (String) Site id for this address or empty string/not present for global

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `id` (String) Device Group ID
- `latest_member_modified_at` (String) The timestamp indicating the last modification of a member in ISO 8601 format
For example '2019-05-08T05:30:30.206Z'
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `name` (String) Display name of the Device Group
- `usage_type` (String) Usage type of the Address Group Must be one of: `device`, `static`.
